decisions.statement: A global flag that takes a value takes the word after that flag.
The words before the act are kept with it, in the order the line has them.
A command with no act is no call here.
A word this names as another tool is no git call whatever its act reads as.
An act is read here rather than judged.
No rule about quoting or basenames exists here.
A hook reads a git act out of a command line without writing a shell parser.

definition: the git invocations a shell command line carries
